body:
@clydin @alan-agius4 thanks for merging the 21.2.x and 20.3.x fixes (#34453 / #34454)! Could this issue be reopened, please? The 22.2.x line is still affected: 22.2.4, released on 2026-10-22 after the issue was closed, still pins `vite@8.3.0`.

```text
$ npm view @angular/build@latest version dependencies.vite dependencies.rolldown
version = '22.2.4'
dependencies.vite = '8.3.0'
dependencies.rolldown = '1.2.8'
```

Now that the advisories are in the npm feed, `npm audit` flags it as high. Since the issue was opened, GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm (CVSS 7.5) and the three vite advisories have also been published:

```text
# npm audit report

vite  8.3.0 - 8.3.2
Severity: high
launch-editor: escapeCmdArgs() omits % escaping on Windows - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-698v-4r3x-3vcv
launch-editor: Editor CLI flag misinterpretation causing arbitrary command execution for some editors - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r825-w8mm-5pxw
launch-editor: `fs.existsSync()` existence check can be bypassed on Windows - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm
Vite: Cross origin script execution through Vite custom middleware - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9jrq-w75r-8gcw
Vite: Files outside `server.fs.allow` could be served when project paths match system paths on non-Windows machine - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-rq7h-c2jc-7f22
Vite: First 4 bytes of files outside of `server.fs` setting is exposed by `?vite-wasm-instance` - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vfpm-58rq-9qcg
fix available via `npm audit fix --force`
Will install @angular/build@22.1.9, which is a breaking change
node_modules/vite
  @angular/build  22.2.0-next.0 - 22.3.0-next.1
  Depends on vulnerable versions of vite
  node_modules/@angular/build

2 vulnerabilities (1 low, 1 high)
```

Both Renovate updates are still pending approval on the Dependency Dashboard (#23493): "build: update dependency vite to v8.3.5 (22.2.x)" and "build: update dependency rolldown to v1.2.15 (22.2.x)". vite 8.3.5 needs `rolldown ~1.2.14`, while 22.2.x pins `1.2.8`. Approving both should fix it.
Yeah, +1 for reopening this as the vite version is not yet bumped in v22
